events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-seven years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. Is it their masterpiece, or do you have another favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders still sound as fresh as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a formidable solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Antics
angles.copy: Our kid, Liam Gallagher, is 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis track or solo anthem from the Manchester legend?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal solo album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember Your iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped! Remember painstakingly curating your playlists on one of these?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first 007 film premiere, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your ultimate 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comic Genius
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 87th birthday to the inimitable John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A sprawling masterpiece or a collection of solo efforts? Let us know what you think.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. Widely seen as a turning point for pop music – what's your top track from the album?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon and peace activist John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, we remember John Lennon. His impact on music and his message of peace continue to resonate around the world.
